name: CRL-40-941
summary: A substance closely related to Adrafinil and Modafinil. It is the bis(p-fluoro) ring derivative of Adrafinil.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Modafinil and its analogues are known to act as dopamine reuptake inhibitors and this is thought to be involved in their wakefulness-promoting effects.

uses.text: Fladrafinil (developmental code name CRL-40,941), also known as fluorafinil or as bisfluoroadrafinil, is a wakefulness-promoting agent related to modafinil that was never marketed. It is sold online and used non-medically as a nootropic (cognitive enhancer).

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Its relatives adrafinil and modafinil can cause headache, sleeplessness, anxiety and nausea, and long-term use of adrafinil has been linked to raised liver enzymes.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。它的近親阿屈非尼與莫達非尼可能造成頭痛、失眠、焦慮與噁心，長期使用阿屈非尼也與肝指數升高有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。它的近亲阿屈非尼与莫达非尼可能造成头痛、失眠、焦虑与恶心，长期使用阿屈非尼也与肝指数升高有关。

fact.en: Fladrafinil is to adrafinil what flmodafinil is to modafinil: the same molecule with one fluorine atom added to each of its two benzene rings.
fact.zh: Fladrafinil 與阿屈非尼的關係，就像 flmodafinil 與莫達非尼一樣：都是在同一個分子的兩個苯環上各加一個氟原子。
fact.zhHans: Fladrafinil 与阿屈非尼的关系，就像 flmodafinil 与莫达非尼一样：都是在同一个分子的两个苯环上各加一个氟原子。
